## Where I am
The real replay into `events.replay.v3` is done: 18,442,107 events produced, 3,118 rejects written to S3. The aggregator backfill for 2026-11-12 was at 61% at last check, with ClickHouse at 14.9M rows against roughly 20.5M expected, so the incident stays open until counts match. Rachel has told Fernhill and Orbitly the data returns by Thursday. PR #241 from a fork is not to be merged; Daniel handles the CI check. (source: ses-rp-2, r2-04, r2-06, r2-07, r2-09)

- [essai-raté] Dry run with 50k batches was OOMKilled at the 2Gi limit; 5k batches work, and the memory limit must not be raised because the namespace quota is capped (source: r1-03, r1-04, src-sentry-oom)
- [question] Fernhill and Orbitly are promised the data by Thursday, and Orbitly's Nov 18 request is still awaiting Rachel's confirmation of the exact date (source: r2-07, src-zendesk-orbitly)
- [décision] Replay everything into `events.replay.v3`, never `events.v3` directly (source: src-slack-incident)
- [décision] No other fix goes in for this incident; Daniel adds the CI check on the dedup key length (source: src-slack-incident, r2-09)
